meta.title: SinoBee.ai — the open-source AI swarm that works on your computer
meta.description: SinoBee official site: try the agent online, download and install, the Skill Hub, crowdfunded AI tasks, and public model and skill evaluations.

footer.tagline: SinoBee is an open-source swarm-intelligence assistant that works on your computer: it researches, reads and writes files, drives a browser and desktop, and hands back tables, charts and files.

home.badge: Open source · MIT · mix cloud and local models
home.lead: SinoBee searches the web, reads files, writes code, runs commands and operates the browser, mouse and keyboard; it also runs scheduled background work and produces complete videos. It delivers tables, charts, files and films. Risky actions ask you first, you can add instructions or stop it mid-task, and it remembers your preferences and gets better over time.
home.shotAlt: SinoBee explaining a GitHub project with a table and a flow chart
home.featuresTitle: One assistant that finishes the job
home.featuresLead: More than chat: SinoBee has tools, layered memory, skills and fixed workflows — and brakes.

research.title: Research
research.body: Reads web pages, news, documents and GitHub projects, cross-checks sources and cites them.

data.title: Data analysis
data.body: Analyzes CSV, Excel, logs and database exports and produces charts and reports.

files.title: File management
files.body: Sorts, renames, converts and batch-processes files — never overwriting a file with the same name.

video.title: AI video production
video.body: One sentence becomes a short film, documentary or ad: script, characters, locations, shot list, voice, rendering, editing and subtitles are automatic, with a draft to approve before the final render. A production kit is exported too, so a sequel keeps the same characters and look.

work.title: Background work & schedules
work.body: Sub-agents working in parallel, fixed workflows (YAML graphs), a shared blackboard and schedules; the Work tab shows past, present and next, and interrupted work can resume.

steer.title: Steer while it works
steer.body: Add instructions or stop a task mid-run; intermediate files appear as links; each stretch of work folds into one summary line. Before finishing it checks the job is really done, and switches to a stronger model when a weak one gets stuck.

browser.title: Browser & desktop
browser.body: A real Chromium with saved logins; Docker mode adds a virtual desktop you can watch and take over.

approval.title: Asks before risky actions
approval.body: Deleting files, installing software, admin rights or force-pushing need your approval; keys and passwords stay on your machine and never reach the model. Modes: confirm, auto, readonly.

memory.title: Layered memory
memory.body: Task, short-term, long-term and permanent memory, tidied, compressed and expired automatically; key facts are saved before a long conversation is summarised. Ratings and your instructions update it, and you can view, pin or delete memories any time.

skills.title: Skills
skills.body: Reusable workflows following the Agent Skills standard. Create with /learn; install from the Hub, GitHub or a folder, with trust levels. Matching skills are suggested automatically, and complex skills can declare fixed workflows.

models.title: Any model
models.body: Mix OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and other cloud models with local Ollama models: pick the main, auxiliary, escalation and fallback models separately. Paste a key, press “Connect”, and its models are verified and listed at once.

usage.title: Usage & budgets
usage.body: Every call logs tokens and cost; set daily and monthly budgets with an alert at 80%.

home.casesTitle: What it can do for you

0.title: Research: explain a GitHub project
0.body: Reads the README and code, summarizes it into a table and an architecture diagram.

1.title: Data: from CSV to charts
1.body: Cleans data, computes metrics, draws charts and writes conclusions.

2.title: Tidy your Downloads folder
2.body: Files by type, consistent names — and shows you the plan before touching anything.

home.casesNote: Screenshots show the real SinoBee interface with demo data.

hub.title: Skill Hub
hub.body: Submit, download, rate and discuss skills, including official ones for AI video production, memory management and database analysis. Upload complete bundles with scripts, references and fixed workflows; reviewed versions are signed with ed25519 and verified by SinoBee on install.

commission.title: Crowdfunded AI tasks
commission.body: Describe what you want AI to do; AI writes the spec and estimates the cost. People back it at NT$30 a share, and once funded the platform runs it in an isolated container and reports to the backers.

bench.title: Model & skill evaluations
bench.body: Anyone can crowdfund an evaluation of a model or a skill. Once the backers accept it, the report is public: time, proposer, skill, model, method, process and result.

home.tryNote: Nothing to install: open a SinoBee at agent.sinobee.ai and try it.
home.casesTry: Every example can be typed straight into the online SinoBee.

video.title: A film from one sentence
video.body: Writes the script, designs characters and locations, plans the shots, records the voice, renders, edits and subtitles — with a draft to approve before the final render. You get the film and a complete production kit.
video.prompt: Make a 30-second documentary about Taiwanese tea

sequel.title: Sequels from a production kit
sequel.body: Attach the kit from the last film: characters, locations, look, music and voices carry over and only the story is new. Or remake the whole film and change details.
sequel.prompt: Use this kit for a sequel: the two meet again on a snowy night

schedule.title: Daily checks on autopilot
schedule.body: Put routine work in the Work tab — database health checks, report roll-ups, site checks — and it runs on time, compares with the last run and writes a report.
schedule.prompt: Check the orders database every day at 9am and report anything unusual

team.title: Split big jobs across a team
team.body: Researcher, analyst and reviewer sub-agents work in parallel, share findings on a blackboard and merge them into one sourced report.
team.prompt: Compare the prices and specs of five cloud hosts in parallel, then merge them into a table

forms.title: Log in, fill forms, download reports
forms.body: A real browser logs in, fills forms, downloads and organizes files; submitting or paying always asks you first.
forms.prompt: Log into the back office, download last month's invoice CSV and combine it in Excel

code.title: Write code and fix bugs
code.body: Understands the project, finds why tests fail, fixes and re-runs them; add requirements while it works, and it checks the fix is real before finishing.
code.prompt: Find out why this project's tests fail and fix them

home.heroAlt: A swarm of robot bees working through a honeycomb: research, documents, analysis, code and files

download.title: Download & install SinoBee
download.lead: Docker is the one-line recommended setup; you can also install it natively to control your own desktop.

docker.title: Docker
docker.body: Windows, macOS or Linux — just Docker Desktop or Docker Engine.

python.title: Python 3.10+
python.body: For the native install; on macOS and Windows SinoBee can control the real desktop.

local.title: Local models (optional)
local.body: On Apple Silicon install Ollama natively; with an NVIDIA GPU use the bundled Ollama container.

download.dockerLead: Install Docker first, then clone and start SinoBee with one command:
download.dockerOpen: Open http://localhost:10024 — setup opens automatically the first time.
download.cloudBody: Under Settings → Model providers, paste an API key and press “Connect”: SinoBee verifies it and loads that provider's models, then pick the main, auxiliary, escalation and fallback models above. Keys stay in secrets.json on the server, only the last four characters are shown, and nothing is written to .env.
download.startWithKeysTitle: Pass the model and key at start-up
download.localLead: No API bills and your data stays home: run open models locally, free and keyless.
download.localMac: On a Mac install and open Ollama first (uses the Metal GPU), then start SinoBee — it connects to host.docker.internal:11434 automatically:
download.localGpu: With an NVIDIA GPU add the GPU compose file:
download.pipLead: Requires Python 3.10 or later. Run the install script once, then use the sinobee command from any folder:
download.pipMacNote: On macOS grant the terminal Accessibility and Screen Recording in System Settings → Privacy & Security. On a physical machine keep the approval mode on confirm.

firstRun.0: Open Settings → Models: paste any provider's key under Model providers and press “Connect”, or open Ollama (local) to download a model; then choose the main model. Cloud and local models can be mixed.
firstRun.1: Describe the result in plain words — the more specific the better, e.g. “make it a table”, “save as report.md”, “make a 30-second product ad”.
firstRun.2: Risky actions show an approval card: allow, deny, or switch to read-only. While a task runs you can type extra instructions or press stop.
firstRun.3: Leave long or recurring work to the Work tab: fixed workflows, sub-agents and schedules live there, with progress and output files at a glance.
firstRun.4: Rate results with thumbs up/down; SinoBee updates its memory and skills. Memory is tidied automatically, and the Memory tab lets you view, pin or delete entries.

download.cliHub: SinoBee ships with a Skill Hub client. To trust this Hub’s review signatures, pin its public key in your config:

0.a: The result card explains the cause and a fix; expand “Technical details” for the raw message. Usually an invalid key, a wrong model name or exhausted quota.

1.a: Install and open Ollama, or run docker compose --profile local-llm up -d, then click “Re-detect”.

2.a: Pick a smaller model labelled “GPU-accelerated”; on a Mac install Ollama natively instead of in a container.

3.q: Local model can’t operate the computer

4.a: git pull && docker compose up -d --build, then hard-refresh the browser; your data lives in Docker volumes and is kept.

5.q: Added a Gemini (or other) key but no models to pick
5.a: Press “Connect” on the provider card: the key is verified at once and its models appear in the list above; “invalid key” means the key needs to be regenerated. On the latest version cloud models can be selected even while the main model is a local one.

6.a: The default port is now 10024: open http://localhost:10024. A server.port in your config.yaml takes precedence.

download.tryOnlineNote: Want a look before installing? Try the SinoBee agent at agent.sinobee.ai.

skills.lead: Submit, download, rate and discuss SinoBee skills. Skills follow the Agent Skills standard and work with other compatible agents — a single SKILL.md or a full bundle with scripts, references, examples and fixed workflows.
skills.cliBody: SinoBee ships with a Hub client: search, install, check for updates and publish skills, verifying content hashes, signatures and the revocation list. Use export to bundle a skill with its scripts and references, then publish.
skills.officialLead: Bundled with SinoBee, published and signed by CAFECA; download them for other compatible agents too.

ai-video-production.title: AI video production
ai-video-production.body: A film from one sentence: script, characters, locations, shots, voice, rendering, editing and subtitles, plus a reusable production kit.

memory-management.title: Memory management
memory-management.body: Turns task highlights into short-term, long-term and permanent memories, compresses on demand, adds or removes on your instruction.

database-analysis.title: Database analysis
database-analysis.body: Read-only queries on PostgreSQL, MySQL and SQLite with metrics, charts and health reports.

web-research.title: Web research
web-research.body: Several searches, at least two sources cross-checked, conclusions with citations.

browser-form-filling.title: Browser forms
browser-form-filling.body: Log in, fill forms, download reports — confirming before anything is submitted or paid.

desktop-automation.title: Desktop automation
desktop-automation.body: Sees the screen, moves the mouse, types — for desktop apps without an API.

code-repo-explainer.title: Code repo explainer
code-repo-explainer.body: Reads the README and source and explains architecture, modules and flows.

skill-authoring.title: Skill authoring
skill-authoring.body: Turns a procedure into a new Agent Skills skill, or improves an existing one.

anatomy.title: Isometric explainers
anatomy.body: Draws a technical idea as a detailed, interactive isometric SVG object with a title, hint and live readout, for docs, blogs and landing pages.

youtube-analysis.title: YouTube video analysis
youtube-analysis.body: Reads a video's metadata, transcript and stills and writes a Markdown report with a timestamped outline, category analysis and fact-check.

engineering-feasibility.title: Engineering feasibility
engineering-feasibility.body: Takes a video or text, tests each claim against physics with a numeric model and gives a verdict; if it works, a 3D animated page shows how the system runs and where it stops, if not, why the key properties cannot be achieved, with a report.

format.title: One folder per skill
format.body: SKILL.md says when to use it and the steps; scripts/, references/ and assets/ hold scripts, references and examples. Upload SKILL.md or the .tar.gz from sinobee skills export.

trust.title: Trust levels and signatures
trust.body: Uploads are scanned for dangerous commands; reviewed versions are ed25519-signed and immutable. SinoBee uses trust levels (builtin, verified, community…) to decide whether scripts may run.

suggest.title: Picked automatically
suggest.body: When a request contains a skill's trigger words, SinoBee names that skill and its quick start, so the model doesn't have to guess.

workflow.title: Skills can ship workflows
workflow.body: Complex skills can declare a YAML workflow (video: plan → draft → approval → final render) that runs from the Work tab in one click, on a schedule, and resumes after interruptions.

submit.title: Submit a skill
submit.lead: Upload a SKILL.md or the .tar.gz produced by sinobee skills export. Published versions are immutable — publish a new version or revoke.
submit.publisherHelp: Your publisher id appears in install commands (hub:<publisher>/<skill>) and cannot change after you publish.
submit.submitted: Submitted for review (downloadable at the “community” trust level until reviewed)
submit.rejected: The automatic security scan marked it dangerous — not listed
submit.formatBody: Frontmatter allows only name, description, license, compatibility, allowed-tools and metadata; name must equal the folder name, and the Hub requires metadata.version (quoted semver).
submit.cliBody: Create a Hub token in your account, then:

review.0: Automatic checks: Agent Skills spec validation, content hash, security scan (prompt injection, credentials, invisible characters, dangerous scripts).
review.1: Versions the scan marks dangerous are not listed; others are downloadable at the “community” trust level.
review.2: After human review the Hub signs the content hash with ed25519 and marks it reviewed.
review.3: Verified publisher + reviewed + valid signature → SinoBee installs it as “verified”.

prices.settingsConfirm: Every model gets a new price row at the new rate and buffer (history is kept). Continue?
prices.modelsHelp: Enter vendor USD prices; the published price updates live. Every save adds a history row instead of overwriting.
prices.label: Name
prices.bufferNeed: Highest active plan multiplier is {mult}×: a buffer ≥ {even} breaks even, ≥ {healthy} keeps a 50% margin. The buffer also sets token prices for crowdfunded tasks.
prices.unknownIds: These offered models are not in their provider's model list and will fail (404): {models}. Fix the IDs or withdraw them.
prices.syncHint: Use model IDs from the provider lists:

plans.help: Enter the fee and the usage multiplier (30-day usage ÷ fee, at published prices); the allowance and the 6-hour (L6) and 7-day (L168) limits are calculated. Published prices include the buffer, so a plan's margin = buffer ÷ usage multiplier — keep it profitable with the buffer under Prices.
plans.name: Name (zh)
plans.formula: Allowance = fee × usage multiplier, L168 = allowance ÷ 4.8, L6 = L168 ÷ 10; tokens use {model} at its current published price (input : output = 3 : 1).
plans.badMult: The usage multiplier must be above 0 and at most {max}.
plans.loss: At the current buffer a user who uses the full allowance costs more than the fee. A buffer of {need} breaks even; {healthy} or more keeps a 50% margin.
plans.thin: Thin margin: a buffer of {healthy} or more keeps a 50% margin.

payments.confirm: Refund {amount} TWD through Oen? Each transaction can be refunded once.
payments.help: Oen notifications are unsigned, so every result is read back with GET /transactions; missed notifications are reconciled by the worker every 3 minutes. One refund per transaction; pledge refunds for funded tasks are limited to the unspent budget, and refunding a subscription cancels that period and moves later ones up.

settings.help: Settings live in the database; secrets are encrypted with AES-256-GCM. Values set by environment variables are locked and must be changed there. Empty keys and passwords are generated automatically.
settings.readOnly: Only the super admin can change settings.

settings.confirmRotate: Generate a new skill signing key? The old public key stays published; signed skills keep verifying.
settings.search: Search by name, key or environment variable…

hubApi.lead: The sinobee.ai Skill Hub protocol v1, compatible with the SinoBee client (sinobee skills search / install / publish / sync-revocations).

trust.0: Download the bundle (≤ 20 MB, ≤ 500 files; path traversal, symlinks and device files are rejected).
trust.1: Validate against the Agent Skills spec; compute the content hash and compare with the Hub’s sha256 — abort on mismatch.
trust.2: Verify the signature (ed25519 over the content_hash string) with the pinned public keys.
trust.3: Abort if the Hub scan says dangerous; run a local security scan as well.
trust.4: Verified publisher, reviewed version and valid signature → verified; otherwise community.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.lead: Plans run 30 days and never renew automatically; usage is charged at SinoBee.ai's published model prices. Crowdfunded tasks are estimated by AI from their expected usage.
pricing.formulaNote: All prices are in TWD, paid through Oen with an e-invoice. Model prices and the exchange rate are locked when a crowdfund is funded; the run is charged by actual usage against the task budget.
pricing.tokensBody: Billed at the published model prices above: uncached input, cache reads, cache writes and output each at their own price — the same table subscriptions use.
pricing.vmBody: Per second while running: {price} TWD per hour ({cpus} vCPU / {mem} GB RAM per task).
pricing.s3Body: Result storage: {gb} TWD per GB-month, prorated by retention; {put} TWD per 1,000 writes and {get} TWD per 1,000 reads.
pricing.modelNote: Published price = vendor USD price × base FX rate {fx} × {buffer}. Subscription quota is drawn down at these prices; changes are announced here with their effective date.
pricing.planNote: Limits are rolling windows. Token counts use {model} at its current published price (input : output = 3 : 1) and follow price changes; cheaper models give more tokens, pricier ones fewer.
pricing.planUsage: Use up to {mult}× the fee (up to NT${value} in 30 days at published prices)

crowd.share: NT${price} a share; back 1, 5 or 20 shares. Cards are only saved while funding and charged when the goal is reached.
crowd.fee: Proposal fee NT${fee}: credit for AI drafting and editing the spec; not refundable.
crowd.goal: The goal is set from AI's estimate of the run (the conservative estimate plus the service fee, rounded up to whole shares).
crowd.leftover: After the task, unused budget goes back to the backers as platform points for other crowdfunds.
crowd.periodNote: Results are kept {days} days for the backers.
crowd.selfNote: no crowdfunding, no fee; charged when the screening passes

share.reported: Thanks — we will look into it.
share.listLead: Conversations people shared publicly from SinoBee.
share.continueHelp: Import this conversation into your SinoBee as a new chat and keep going. SinoBee must be running on this computer.
share.noThumbnail: No picture (platforms show the SinoBee.ai default)
share.previewHelp: LINE, Facebook, X, Slack and others show the picture, title and this summary when the link is pasted.
share.previewHidden: Sign-in shares never show their title, summary or picture to others.

checkout.name: Name
checkout.agree: I have read and agree to the <terms>Terms of Service</terms>, <refunds>Refund Policy</refunds> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>, and ask for the service to start right after payment (online services are not subject to the 7-day withdrawal right; refunds follow the Refund Policy).
checkout.oenNote: Oen (應援科技) charges the card you pick in TWD and issues the e-invoice.
checkout.noCard: No saved card yet. Bind a card once; every later payment just charges the card you pick.
checkout.bindNote: Binding happens on Oen's secure page (3-D Secure) and charges nothing; SinoBee.ai never sees your card number.
checkout.bindingPending: Waiting for Oen to confirm the card…
checkout.testCards: Test mode: test payments only; nothing is really charged.

subscribe.title: Subscribe to SinoBee.ai
subscribe.lead: 30-day periods, no auto-renewal. Buying again adds a period after the current one.
subscribe.limits: About {l6} tokens per 6 h, {l168} per 7 days · {n} requests at a time
subscribe.grace: Your subscription has ended; the grace period lasts until
subscribe.stacks: The new period starts on {date}, after your current one.
subscribe.startsNow: Starts as soon as the charge goes through; 30 days from payment.

ok.SUBSCRIPTION: Your subscription is active. Oen emails the e-invoice.
ok.CROWD_PROPOSAL: Received the {amount} TWD proposal fee; AI is drafting the spec.

payReturn.pending: Checking the result with Oen; this page updates by itself.
payReturn.charging: Waiting for your convenience-store or ATM payment (up to 3 days); this page updates afterwards.
payReturn.failed: This payment did not go through and nothing was charged. You can try again.

err.V0002: The payment page timed out (5 minutes). Please try again.
err.V0003: The result is not final yet; please wait.
err.T0001: The payment failed (including 3-D Secure). Try another card or later.

notary.title: Notarized on Boltchain
notary.verify: The SHA-256 of the downloaded text matches the certificate.
notary.public: The markdown text of these terms is kept publicly on Boltchain: download it from the certificate page, where your browser checks every block against the hashes.
notary.publicPending: Once notarized, the markdown text of these terms is kept publicly on Boltchain and can be downloaded from the certificate page.

crowd.title: Crowdfunded tasks
crowd.lead: Back the tasks you need with others. One share is NT${price}; pledge 1, 5 or 20 shares at a time. Nothing is charged unless the goal is reached.
crowd.newLead: Just describe what you want AI to do: AI writes the whole spec, picks the category and estimates the cost. You check it line by line or ask AI for changes, pick a period and submit.

steps.0: Describe it and pay the NT${fee} proposal fee
steps.1: AI writes the spec and the estimate; edit lines or ask AI
steps.2: Pick a period and submit; it opens once screening passes

form.description: What do you want AI to do?
form.placeholder: For example: survey the accessibility features of every bus stop in Taipei and write a report by district with suggestions.
form.placeholderEval: For example: compare this skill's accuracy and consistency across question types.
form.descriptionHint: Write the background, the result you want and any limits in your own words. AI writes the title, category, spec and estimate.
form.title: Title
form.titleAuto: Leave empty for AI to name it
form.feeLine: Proposal fee NT${fee}: credit for AI drafting and editing the spec, not refundable; what is left joins the task budget when funded.
form.create: Pay NT${fee} and draft the spec
form.after: After paying you come back to the proposal; AI drafts the spec in about a minute.

edit.title: Crowdfunding proposal
edit.draft: Draft: only you can see it. Finish the spec and pay the proposal fee to open pledges.
edit.feeNote: The proposal fee is non-refundable and becomes credit for the spec dialogue tokens and reference file storage. When it runs out the dialogue stops until you buy more; unused credit joins the task budget when funded (not a share, never points).
edit.confirmDiscard: Discard this proposal? The proposal fee is not refunded.

chat.title: Ask AI to edit
chat.empty: Tell AI what to change, e.g. "add an English version to the deliverables".
chat.needFee: Pay the proposal fee to start the dialogue.
chat.outOfCredit: Proposal credit used up; buy another proposal fee to continue.
chat.failed: The AI did not finish its reply. Please try again.

spec.title: Spec
spec.empty: No spec yet. Start the dialogue or fill it in by hand.

files.title: Reference files
files.note: Up to {free} MB costs only storage; every further {block} MB uses one share (NT${price}) of credit, {max} MB in total.

visHelp.AGENT: only the agent running the task

open.title: Submit the proposal
open.minGoal: At least {min} TWD (P90 estimate plus the fee, in whole shares of {price})
open.startEarly: Start as soon as the goal is reached
open.startEarlyHint: Charge and start once the pledges reach the goal; later pledges are charged at once and added to the budget.
open.confirm: The spec cannot be changed after submitting. Submit for screening?
open.afterSubmit: AI checks it against the public screening checklist; it opens for pledges when every item passes, and the period starts then.
open.selfAuto: You pay NT${goal} once (the AI's conservative estimate, no service fee); your card is charged as soon as the screening passes and the task starts.
open.selfPublic: Make the task and results public
open.selfPublicOn: The task, its progress and results are shown on the crowdfunding pages; nobody else can pledge.
open.selfPublicOff: Only you can see the task, its progress and results.
open.confirmSelf: The spec cannot be changed after submitting. When the screening passes, NT${amount} is charged to the chosen card at once. Submit?
open.afterSubmitSelf: The AI screens it against the public checklist; if it passes your card is charged and the task starts, otherwise nothing is charged.

panel.cardNote: During the campaign the card is only saved; it is charged once when the goal is reached and the e-invoice goes to your email.
panel.pointsNote: Points are deducted now and returned if the goal is missed.
panel.quotaNote: Quota is deducted now; it comes back as quota (never cash or points) if the goal is missed or budget is left.
panel.closed: This task is not taking pledges.
panel.leftover: Unused budget becomes platform points for the backers, in proportion to their pledges (no cash refunds).
panel.chargingNote: The goal is reached; backers are being charged.
panel.unfundedNote: The goal was not reached; nobody was charged.
panel.needsFundingNote: Budget used up: pledges now are charged at once and the run continues.
panel.retention: Crowdfunded results are kept {days} days; every backer whose pledge was collected can download them.
panel.self: Paid in full by the proposer
panel.selfNote: Paid in full by the proposer; not open for pledges.
panel.selfCharging: Screening passed; charging the proposer's card.
panel.selfPaid: Paid by the proposer; not open for pledges.
panel.selfFailed: The card charge did not go through; the task did not run.
panel.pointsCover: Your points cover this pledge: no card is charged. Points are deducted now and returned if the goal is missed.
panel.split: Points pay NT${p}, the card NT${c}.
panel.quotaAll: Pays the full amount; points are not used

account.pointsNote: 1 point = NT$1, only for crowdfunding pledges; not transferable and never paid out in cash.
account.cardsNote: Oen keeps the card (3-D Secure); this site stores only an encrypted charge token, used when a crowdfund reaches its goal.

mock.title: Test card binding
mock.note: Test payments: this is SinoBee's simulated binding page; no real card is saved and nothing is ever charged.
mock.decline: Bind a test card that gets declined

review.title: Acceptance review
review.intro: The agent has finished. Download the results and vote against the acceptance criteria; your vote counts with the shares you paid for.
review.reason: Why it is rejected (the agent reworks with it)
review.onlyBackers: Only backers whose pledge was collected can vote.
review.rule: Accepted when approving shares reach {pct}% of the shares that voted (no votes = accepted). If rejected, the agent reworks it up to {n} time(s) while budget lasts; otherwise the platform decides.
review.disputed: Rejected with no rework left; waiting for the platform's decision.

revise.title: Revise the spec
revise.intro: You can revise the spec while the campaign is open. The goal stays the same, so the new P90 must still fit. Nothing is charged for {hours} hours after a revision; backers may withdraw.
revise.exitUntil: The spec was just revised: nothing is charged before {date}; backers who disagree can withdraw.

topup.title: Top-up round
topup.intro: The budget ran out. Open a {days}-day top-up round: backers are charged only if it reaches its goal, then the run continues; otherwise the task closes with the results so far.
topup.round: Top-up round: NT${pledged} of NT${goal} pledged

explore.title: Crowdfunded tasks
explore.lead: Tasks people fund together for SinoBee to do. NT${price} a share, nothing charged unless the goal is reached, leftover budget returned as points.

rep.line: Funded {funded}/{decided} ended · accepted {accepted} ({firstPass} first time) · backed {backed} tasks

share.title: Share this crowdfund
share.copyText: Copy title, summary and link (for Instagram, Discord and others)
share.hint: Platforms read this page's picture, title and summary; the picture updates as funding progresses.

report.reason: Which rules does this crowdfund break?
report.done: Thanks, the platform will look at it.

screening.pending: Under screening: an AI checks every item of the Crowdfunding Terms, then the platform confirms the result and notifies you; if all are met it starts (a campaign's period starts then).
screening.rejected: The proposal did not pass screening: {passed} items met, {failed} not met (of {total}, checklist version {v}). Any item not met fails the proposal. Fix the following and submit again:
screening.rerun: Add a note and ask the AI again
screening.rerunHelp: Admins cannot change the AI's answers; add a note and the AI screens it again — every item must still be met.
screening.notePlaceholder: For example: every data source in the proposal is government open data under the Open Government Data License.
screening.queued: Queued; the worker starts in a few seconds.
screening.waiting: The AI could not finish the screening; it retries automatically.
screening.running: AI screening: {done} of {total} dimensions done ({items} items)
screening.busyHelp: You can confirm or ask for a re-review once the AI has finished.
screening.aiApprove: AI result: every item met — approve
screening.aiReject: AI result: some items not met — send back
screening.confirmHelp: The proposer is told at once.
screening.confirmApprove: Confirm the AI's result? The proposer is notified and the campaign opens now.
screening.confirmApproveSelf: Confirm the AI's result? The proposer is notified, their card is charged and the task starts.
screening.confirmReject: Confirm the AI's result? The proposal goes back to draft and the proposer gets the failed items and reasons.
screening.sentBackDone: Sent back; the proposer was notified
screening.awaitingReview: The AI has finished; the platform will confirm the result and notify you.

crowd.agreeTerms: I have read and agree to the <terms>Crowdfunding Terms</terms>, including every proposal screening item.

draft.payTitle: Pay the proposal fee and AI drafts the spec
draft.working: AI is drafting the spec and the estimate…
draft.workingHint: Deliverables, method, acceptance criteria and cost from your description; usually under a minute.
draft.aiCategory: (chosen by AI, you can change it)
draft.failed: The AI did not finish the draft. Please try again.

doc.hint: Click any line to edit it; Enter saves, Esc cancels. Or ask AI on the right.
doc.askAi: AI decides this part; tell AI on the right to change it.
doc.estimateLine: Typically NT${p50}, conservatively NT${p90} (the goal uses the conservative estimate)

checklist.aiHint: Describe the items to add, remove or change; the AI updates the draft (it does not publish).
checklist.aiPlaceholder: e.g. add an item under safety confirming the task gives no medical diagnosis
checklist.confirmDiscard: Discard the draft and go back to the public version?
checklist.note: Version note (public in the Crowdfunding Terms)
checklist.confirmPublish: Once published it is public in the Crowdfunding Terms, notarized on Boltchain and applies to proposals submitted afterwards. Publish?

test.banner: Test mode: every payment goes to Oen's testing environment; nothing is really charged.
test.help: Shows a TEST ribbon on the home page and in the admin, and sends payments and card bindings to Oen's testing environment (test cards only); test payments are left out of revenue.
test.confirmOn: Turn test mode on? Payments will go to Oen's testing environment and people need to bind test cards.
test.confirmOff: Turn test mode off? Payments will be real again; cards bound during the test cannot be used.
